additions.name: Ruti
additions.note: Women's clothing boutique from Israel, open in Town & Country Village since November 2009. The store is still listed at 855 El Camino Real #45.

additions.name: Sweet 55
additions.note: Swiss chocolate shop at Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online reported a June 17, 2022 grand opening for the Palo Alto store at 855 El Camino Real Suite 123, and a November 2026 Peninsula shopping guide still lists SWEET55 at Town & Country Village.

additions.name: Coyuchi
additions.note: Organic bedding and home-goods store at Town & Country Village, opened in November 2022. A current listing still places it at 855 El Camino Real, Suite 5.

additions.name: Sushi House
additions.note: Japanese restaurant in Town & Country Village. A current Palo Alto directory lists Sushi House at 855 El Camino Real Suite 158 and dates it to 1988 at the same address; a 2015 student restaurant guide also says it opened in 1988.

additions.name: The Penny Ice Creamery
additions.note: Ice cream shop in Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online reported in February 2023 that The Penny Ice Creamery was expected to open that April at 855 El Camino Real #121, and its August 2023 ice-cream guide listed the Palo Alto shop operating there; the creamery's site still lists Palo Alto hours.

additions.name: Gott's Roadside
additions.note: Burger restaurant in Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online's October 11, 2013 Shop Talk said Gott's Roadside had opened the previous month in Town & Country Village; a current Palo Alto directory lists it at 855 El Camino Real Suite 65 and says it has served there since 2013.

additions.name: Oren’s Hummus Express
additions.note: Quick-service Israeli restaurant in Town & Country Village. Palo Alto Online reported the prototype Oren’s Hummus Express would open May 8, 2019 at Town & Country Village Suite 162; a current Palo Alto directory still lists the Express at 855 El Camino Real Suite 162 as a separate location.

additions.name: Poke House
additions.note: Poke restaurant in Town & Country Village that replaced pokéLOVE. Palo Alto Online reported it soft-opened in January 2019 and held a grand opening on January 27, 2019.

additions.name: Serena & Lily
additions.note: Home furnishings design shop at Town & Country Village that opened November 11, 2023. Its about 3,200-square-foot showroom sells furniture, bedding and home accessories.

additions.name: Marine Layer
additions.note: Casual clothing store at Town & Country Village that opened in 2015 and doubled to about 1,800 square feet in December 2022. A current Palo Alto shopping guide still lists it in Building 1 of the center.

additions.name: Manresa Bread
additions.note: Bakery in Town & Country Village that opened April 15, 2022 in a space of about 1,700 square feet at 855 El Camino Real, Suite 138. A current Palo Alto visitor guide still lists it there, open daily.

fields.note: Hair salon listed at 933 Emerson St in a 2009 Best of Silicon Valley readers' poll and still open today. It may have opened before 2009.
